info.title: Tilo API
info.description: Every resource of a Tilo workspace, its fields and its actions, over HTTP: docs/developers/api.md says how. Each app's actions take the arguments and answer the result its surface declares: `x-tilo-actions` lists them, each naming its arguments' schema.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: The API itself, the person's account and their workspaces

tags.name: Keys
tags.description: Keys a program holds, and the keys minted from them

tags.name: Actions
tags.description: Running an action on a resource

tags.name: Runs
tags.description: An action's run after it answered: awaiting, cancelling, undoing it

tags.name: Events
tags.description: What changes in a workspace, as it changes

tags.name: Webhooks

tags.name: Files
tags.description: Bytes going into a workspace and coming out of it

tags.name: Members

tags.name: Programs
tags.description: Several calls as one step, written in tilolang

Error.description: Every refusal, whatever route it came from.

code.description: Stable and typed: what a program branches on.

next_steps.description: Calls that would work, each a sentence.

retry_after_ms.description: How long to wait before the same call works.

revoked_at_ms.description: When the key was revoked, for `key_revoked`.

action.description: The action refused, with what it takes, for an action's refusal.

kind.description: `read`, `undoable` or `outside`: what running it may reach.

schema.description: The JSON schema of the value, where the app gives one.

Param.description: One parameter of an action, as its app publishes it.

key.description: What the key sent reaches, when one was sent.

scope.description: `all` or the one workspace it reaches.

created_by.description: The person's device that approved it.

expires_at_ms.description: `null` for a key that lasts until revoked.

Account.description:
The person's account on their host: their plan, and per workspace what it
keeps and the VM time it ran.

id.description: What every route names it by.

host.description:
The host that keeps it: a relay's name, or the person's device that
hosts it; absent while none of their devices said.

role.description: `owner` for one of the person's own, else the role they hold there.

revoked_keys.description: The keys that reached only it, revoked with it.

name.description: How History and the grants page name its agent.

expires_in.description: Seconds until it expires; at most this key's own lifetime and 89 days.

mcp_url.description: Where an agent connects with it over MCP.

path.description: The path listed; `apps` for the apps.

actions.description: The actions of the resource listed.

next_cursor.description: Passed back as `cursor` for the rest.

kind.description: The app's type of it, or `app`.

Row.description: One row of a listing: a resource under the path listed, or an app.

fields.description: The app's own fields, with its own types.

cursor.description: The app's cursor for the next page.

surface.description: For an app: its surface (`surface.toml`), what types are generated from.

surface_version.description: For an app: its surface's version, `<app>@<digest>`.

item.description: The key a read takes it by.

Child.description: A list of what a resource holds, one entry of it.

status.description: `ok`, `pending` or `cancelled`. (A failure is the error shape.)

path.description: The action at the resource it resolved to, `app/resource#action`.

result.description: The action's output, as the app typed it.

link.description: The link to the record it changed.

links.description: Every record it changed, once each.

edited_by_person.description: What actually ran, when the person changed the arguments first.

ask.description: What the person is being asked, while it waits for them.

undone.description: What was undone, for an undo.

ActionAnswer.description: An action's answer, and a run's.

url.description: Where the person answers it, when a page for it exists.

Ask.description: What the person is asked before an action runs.

action.description: The action the hit offers; `open` when it opens the resource itself.

link.description: Opens it in its app for the workspace's members; carries no secret.

Members.description:
The workspace's people, each with their role, and the invitations still
open.

email.description: The address the invitation names; no mail is sent.

Invitation.description: A link that signs the person in and lands them in the workspace.

confirm.description:
Runs a program that would change much or destroy something; without
it such a program answers `preview`.

output.description: The program's answer, a line per element.

steps.description: Every step of the run that changed something, oldest first.

content.description: `tilo.content:<hash>`: what an action takes the file as.

id.description: The cursor after it: `Last-Event-ID` resumes there.

data.description: The event as its kind gives it.

Event.description: One event of a workspace's stream, or of a webhook's delivery.

events.description: The kinds to post (`change`, `run`, `presence`); all without it.

path.description: One resource's changes only, and what is under it.

secret.description: What deliveries are signed with: answered once, when it is made.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Names this attempt: a retry with the same key answers what the first did and runs nothing twice

Run.name: Tilo-Run
Run.description: The run this call is a step of: every call naming it is one undo step per app
